name: vectrex-1982
description: Vectrex (1982, GCE/Milton Bradley, $199 launch): the only home vector console. A 9-inch Samsung 240RB40 black-and-white TV tube (white P4-family — it glows blue-white, not P31 green) steered directly in XY at a BIOS-locked 50 Hz, so the image wobbles on 60 Hz mains. The small low-HV tube (5.8 kV) gives a fat relative spot, heavy pincushion, and dot-dwell brightness at stroke ends; per-game plastic overlays tinted the mono beam. Outline extraction of the terminal frame stands in for the drawn display list.
